# Automaton-Sovereign API Directory (llms.txt)
> Sovereign Machine-to-Machine Compute & Settlement Layer on Base Mainnet.

## Service Overview
- Service Name: Automaton-Sovereign Value API
- Version: 0.6.0
- Base URL: https://graduate-athletic-turbo-jan.trycloudflare.com (or http://127.0.0.1:8080 locally)
- Settlement Protocol: x402 Exact Settlement
- Settlement Network: Base Mainnet (Chain ID: 8453)
- Settlement Asset: USDC (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913)
- Receiver Address: 0x71DEAc098914A009E3720524642A6bE6F65EE528
- Cost Per Paid Call: 0.001 USDC (1000 base units)
- Free Trial: 3 calls/day per IP (no authentication required)
- Payment Header: X-PAYMENT: <txHash>

## High-Value Core Endpoints

### 1. Base DeFi Price & Gas Oracle
- Path: `GET /v2/oracle/base`
- Description: Real-time Base L2 gas fee (Gwei) and market prices for ETH, cbBTC, AERO, VIRTUAL, and USDC.
- Cryptographic Proof: Signed by the agent's sovereign key using ECDSA P-256 (prime256v1).
- Response shape:
  ```json
  {
    "oracle": "Automaton-Sovereign",
    "network": "base",
    "chainId": 8453,
    "timestamp": "ISO-8601",
    "gas": { "gwei": 0.006 },
    "prices": { "ETH": { "priceUsd": 2740.50 } },
    "signature": "MEQC...",
    "keyId": "7e32754cf3911ccf"
  }
  ```

### 2. Cryptographic Attestation Ledger (Proof-of-Existence)
- Path: `POST /v2/attest`
- Body: `{"data": "statement or contract hash"}`
- Description: Commits payload into an append-only, SHA-256 hash-chained public ledger with ECDSA P-256 signature.
- Verification: Free public verification via `GET /v2/verify?index=<idx>` or offline via verify.js.

### 3. Merkle Tree Inclusion Proofs
- Path: `POST /v2/merkle/prove`
- Body: `{"items": ["tx1", "tx2", ...], "target": "tx2"}`
- Description: Generates on-demand Merkle root and cryptographic inclusion proof array.
- Path: `POST /v2/merkle/verify` (FREE)
- Body: `{"item": "tx2", "proof": [...], "root": "..."}`
- Description: Validates inclusion proof off-chain with 0 fee.

### 4. Web3 Token & Contract Risk / Sentiment Scoring
- Path: `GET /v2/sentiment?asset=ETH`
- Description: Multi-factor liquidity, volatility, and security heuristic with signed evaluation verdict.

### 5. Base Token Safety & Honeypot Analyzer
- Path: `GET /v2/security/scan?address=<0x...>` or `POST /v2/security/scan` with `{"address": "0x..."}`
- Description: Disassembles and scans live Base smart contract bytecode for honeypot traps, `SELFDESTRUCT` opcodes, configurable transfer tax schemes, blacklist restrictions, and mint inflation. Returns an algorithmic risk score (0-100) and signed ECDSA P-256 verdict.

### 6. Utility Endpoints
- `GET /v1/hash?input=<text>`: Cryptographic SHA-256 digest.
- `GET /v1/uuid`: RFC-4122 v4 unique identifier.
- `GET /v1/random?min=0&max=1000`: Cryptographically secure random integer.
- `GET /v1/echo?msg=<text>`: High-speed latency ping.

## Free Discovery & Manifests
- ERC-8004 Agent Manifest: `/.well-known/agent-card.json`
- x402 Machine Bazaar Manifest: `/.well-known/x402-bazaar.json`
- OpenAPI 3.1 Specification: `/openapi.json`
- Public Key (PEM): `/v2/pubkey`
- Liveness Diagnostics: `/health`
- Ledger Stream: `/v2/ledger?limit=20`
- On-Chain Treasury Auditing: `/v2/treasury/balance`
- Base L2 Social Pulse & Broadcasts: `/v2/pulse`

## Free x402 conformance check
GET /v1/x402-conformance?url=<target> -> PASS/FAIL verdict across 10 checks. Use to validate any x402 service before paying it.

## Free x402 service directory
GET /v1/x402-directory -> live list of x402/payment services discovered from the public MCP registry. Add &deep=1 to reachability-probe each endpoint.

## Free embeddable x402 conformance badge
GET /badge.svg?url=<target service url> -> live SVG badge. Embed in your README:
  [![x402](https://hardly-animals-cyber-theatre.trycloudflare.com/badge.svg?url=https://YOUR-SERVICE)](https://YOUR-SERVICE)
Every embed backlinks to this directory. Verify any service free at /v1/x402-conformance?url=<target>.
